page_title: CHE 1-1 NOT | Chelsea v Nottingham Forest 06/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+15' Chris Kavanagh is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+14' Nottingham earn a corner.

90+14' That was a brilliant piece of goalkeeping! Robert Sanchez dived superbly to block a header by Jota Silva (Nottingham) from around the penalty spot. His effort was directed straight towards the left post, but Robert Sanchez pulled off a remarkable save!
90+13' Ryan Yates (Nottingham) takes the corner with a short pass.
90+12' Wesley Fofana (Chelsea) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card. Wesley Fofana (Chelsea) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
90+10' Neco Williams (Nottingham) attempts to score with a first-time shot from the edge of the box. His low effort towards the middle of the goal is saved by Robert Sanchez.
90+10' A clumsy foul by Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) and Chris Kavanagh blows his whistle.
90+8' Pedro Neto (Chelsea) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
90+7' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) received a pass and didn't think long what to do with it. He fired a powerful long-range shot which went painfully close to the right post.
90+6' Christopher Nkunku (Chelsea) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
90+6' The corner from Pedro Neto (Chelsea) is cleared away by the defence. Chelsea have been awarded a corner kick.
90+6' The ball goes out for a corner. Chelsea can continue in their attacking effort.
90+6' Malo Gusto (Chelsea) takes a nice touch on the edge of the box as he meets a pass and produces a shot towards the roof of the net. What an excellent save by the goalkeeper!
90+5' A quickly taken corner by Chelsea.
90+5' Matz Sels makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded towards the right-hand post by Christopher Nkunku (Chelsea) after a cross from the side. Now Chelsea have a corner.

90+5' Neco Williams (Nottingham) runs with the ball towards the keeper and pulls the trigger from close range, but Robert Sanchez anticipates his intention and makes an amazing save to stop the shot going into the right side of the target.

90+5' Matz Sels (Nottingham) obviously intended to delay the restart of play and the referee blows the whistle. Matz Sels (Nottingham) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
90+3' The substitution is prepared. Tosin Adarabioyo (Chelsea) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Levi Colwill.
90+3' What a chance that is! Pedro Neto swings the ball into the box, and Joao Felix (Chelsea) gets in front of his man and powers his header just wide of the right post.
90' The fourth official shows 13 min. of added time.
90' Enzo Maresca prepares a substitution. Noni Madueke is replaced by Pedro Neto (Chelsea).
90' It's time for a substitution. Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) comes on in place of Jadon Sancho.
89' The referee is firm and issues Levi Colwill (Chelsea) a deserved yellow card.
89' This is a yellow card! Marc Cucurella (Chelsea) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear. Marc Cucurella (Chelsea) will miss the next game.
89' Neco Williams (Nottingham) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
88' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.

87' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a sitter. His shot was directed towards the right post, but the goalkeeper pulls off a marvellous diving save and denies him. Cole Palmer (Chelsea) is first to latch onto the rebound inside the penalty area. He sends a shot towards the right post, but it is denied by the goalkeeper with a superb save.
85' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) whips in a cross from the corner, but Matz Sels is well positioned and punches the ball away.
85' Malo Gusto (Chelsea) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. The linesman makes the right call and Chelsea will have a corner.
82' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Morato (Nottingham) comes onto the pitch so that Callum Hudson-Odoi can be given a rest.
82' Chris Wood goes off the pitch and Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) comes on.
82' Nuno Espirito Santo has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Neco Williams (Nottingham) replacing Alex Moreno.
81' Here is a change. Enzo Fernandez is going off and Enzo Maresca gives the last tactical orders to Joao Felix (Chelsea).
81' The substitution has been made. Christopher Nkunku (Chelsea) has replaced Nicolas Jackson.

79' Noni Madueke (Chelsea) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging. The ball goes out of play and Nottingham will have a goal kick.
78' The manager won't be happy after James Ward-Prowse (Nottingham) receives another yellow card and is sent off.
76' James Ward-Prowse (Nottingham) releases a promising shot from the free kick on the edge of the box. His effort towards the roof of the net is comfortably saved by Robert Sanchez.
76' Nuno Espirito Santo is forced to make a change. Morgan Gibbs-White is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Nicolas Dominguez (Nottingham).
75' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) is shown the yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee. It could have been worse!
74' Referee Chris Kavanagh halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Nuno Espirito Santo, then shows him a yellow.
71' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
70' Noni Madueke (Chelsea) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Chris Kavanagh blows for a foul. Nottingham have a free kick from a promising distance.
70' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
70' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
69' Noni Madueke (Chelsea) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Corner kick. Chelsea will have an opportunity.
66' Here comes a substitution. Jota Silva (Nottingham) is brought on as a substitute for Elliot Anderson.
66' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) has a snap shot at goal from distance after a rebound falls his way, but the effort is wild and flies miles wide of the left post.
66' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
65' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
63' Noni Madueke (Chelsea) wastes a golden opportunity inside the box by shooting straight into the back of an opponent when the goal was at his mercy.
62' The corner from Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) is hurriedly cleared.
61' A cross into the box from Malo Gusto (Chelsea) is cleared. It will be a corner kick for Chelsea.
60' Jadon Sancho plays a pass to Noni Madueke (Chelsea), but he fails to get a decent shot away from inside the box and the ball goes high over the bar.
59' A brilliant cross into the box finds Noni Madueke (Chelsea), who directs his header to the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper shows his reflexes and makes an astonishing save.
57' 1 - 1 Goal - 1:1! Cole Palmer tees up Noni Madueke (Chelsea) inside the box and he rolls the ball into the bottom left corner and past Matz Sels.
56' Noni Madueke (Chelsea) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.

54' A pass travels right across the box to Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) and gives him a sight of goal. He tries to beat the keeper inside the right post, but Robert Sanchez denies him with a decent save.
54' Nicolas Jackson nearly gets in a one-on-one with the goalkeeper after a defence-splitting pass from Cole Palmer (Chelsea), but one of the defenders makes a clearance to snuff out the chance.
52' Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.

49' 0 - 1 GOAL! Nikola Milenkovic jumps high to meet the resulting free kick and nods the ball into the path of Chris Wood (Nottingham), who is unmarked inside the box and slots the ball into the back of the net. It's 0:1.
49' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the right post is denied by a decent save from Robert Sanchez.
47' The keeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) sacrificed accuracy for power, and thus his attempt went well wide of the right post.
46' Chris Kavanagh blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' A first-time shot by Cole Palmer (Chelsea) inside the box is unwittingly blocked by one of his own players.
45+1' Ryan Yates (Nottingham) is clearly in an offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
45' James Ward-Prowse (Nottingham) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
44' Ryan Yates (Nottingham) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender. Nottingham have been awarded a corner kick.

42' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) gets to a rebound in front of goal and sends the ball towards the crossbar. However, he couldn't beat Matz Sels, who shows off his superb goalkeeping ability by pulling off a great save.
42' Half-chance! Noni Madueke (Chelsea) plays a pass into the box, but Matz Sels reacts well to snuff out the attack.
39' Murillo (Nottingham) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the right side of the target, but Robert Sanchez easily deals with the threat.
38' Jadon Sancho (Chelsea) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Matz Sels intercepts the ball.
37' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.
36' James Ward-Prowse (Nottingham) is the one who receives a yellow card.
35' The opposition give Ryan Yates (Nottingham) far too much space and he has a go from long range, but the goal isn't threatened as the ball goes well wide of the left post.
34' One of the players from Chelsea times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
32' 5:1 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams. The shots on goal statistics – 0:1.
28' Nottingham are ruled offside.
27' Jadon Sancho finds Malo Gusto (Chelsea) unmarked on the edge of the box, but his thunderbolt of shot goes high over the bar.
24' Noni Madueke (Chelsea) does well on the edge of the box to find space and powers a shot in on goal that just goes over the bar.
24' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) takes the corner but it's cleared.
22' James Ward-Prowse (Nottingham) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick, but his poor effort goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Chelsea will have a goal kick.
21' Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
18' Malo Gusto (Chelsea) looks to pass after collecting a rebound, but a lack of options forces him to shoot from distance and it's easily blocked by an opponent.
16' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Chris Wood. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Chelsea.

14' Noni Madueke (Chelsea) weaves through the defence with ease and gets into a good position in front of goal. He pulls the trigger in an effort to beat the keeper, but fails as the ball zooms around the right post.
12' What a save from Robert Sanchez! Ryan Yates (Nottingham) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant stop to keep it out.
11' Ola Aina (Nottingham) sends the ball into the penalty area from a throw-in as if it's a corner kick.
10' Noni Madueke (Chelsea) lacks options so goes solo. It's a fine run and good shot from inside the box, but it's a whisker past the right post.
10' Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again.
9' Marc Cucurella (Chelsea) commits a foul and Chris Kavanagh immediately signals a free kick.
8' Murillo (Nottingham) sends a long ball forward to Alex Moreno, but he put too much power and the chance is gone.
6' Malo Gusto (Chelsea) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
4' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Matz Sels, who smothers the ball.
4' Noni Madueke (Chelsea) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.
3' Jadon Sancho (Chelsea) and Enzo Fernandez attempt to exchange short two-yard passes, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
1' Chris Kavanagh has a clear sight and sees a foul from Ryan Yates (Nottingham).
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Nottingham will kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Chris Kavanagh.
